//: Tripix policy: the built-in table plus the Aweiro production-host, deploy-path and dev-host rules. This file replaces collab/config/policy.json for Tripix, and the loader refuses it if it weakens the built-in table: every built-in class and rule must stay (same pattern, class not weaker, never_standing kept). An ADDED rule below the built-in unmatched class is accepted only with lowers_default: true and a justification, and `collab check-config` lists it.
//evaluation: ALL rules are evaluated and the HIGHEST severity among the matches wins; approval is mandatory if any match says so. An action that matches nothing falls to `unmatched_class` — SECURITY_SENSITIVE, i.e. ask.

READ_ONLY.summary: Reads the tree, git, docs or test output. Changes nothing.

SAFE_WRITE.summary: Edits source, tests or docs in the working tree; git can bring it back.

EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT.summary: Reaches something outside this machine that other people can see.

DESTRUCTIVE.summary: Discards work or data that git cannot bring back.

SECURITY_SENSITIVE.summary: Touches credentials, permissions or anything that grants access.

FINANCIAL.summary: Costs the owner money, now or on the next invoice.

//never_standing: An approval for a `never_standing` class authorises ONE action, matched by fingerprint, and is consumed when used. A grant to buy one thing can never authorise buying another.

rules.pattern: subscription|billing|invoice|paid plan|upgrade .*plan|purchase|\bbuy\b|pricing tier|credit card|api credits|paid (api|account|tier)|register .*domain|provision .*(cloud|instance|cluster)|\b(stripe|terraform apply|npm publish|gh release)\b|подписк|оплат|платн|биллинг|тариф|купить|покуп|приобрет|инвойс|кредитн[а-яё]* карт|за деньги|списани[ея] средств
rules.reason: Anything that can appear on an invoice needs a fresh, single-use authorisation from the owner.
Cloud CLIs create billable resources; the free-looking subcommands are not distinguishable here.
ADR-0010 already bars agents from production; this keeps the same line in the collaboration layer.
Production hostnames. The dev host is dev.aweiro.com and is matched by the dev-host rule below.
Editing the deploy path is one command away from running it.

rules.pattern: credential|secret|\btoken\b|api ?key|key ?api|password|\.env\b|serviceaccount|\biam\b|firewall|deploy key|rotate |секрет|пароль|уч[её]тн[а-яё]* данн|апи-? ?ключ|api ?ключ|ключ ?(апи|api)|ключ доступа|приватн[а-яё]* ключ|токен|креденш|ротаци[а-яё]* ключ
rules.reason: Credentials are never read, written or quoted through this layer.
Discards work or data git cannot restore.

rules.pattern: \bgit\s+push\b|pull request|open a pr\b|slack|send (an )?e-?mail|post to |publish|запуш|пулл-?реквест|пул-?реквест|отправить письмо|написать в слак|в слак|опубликова|выложить|отправить .*на сервер
rules.reason: Leaves this machine and is visible to other people; push also starts CI.
The dev backend is where agents are meant to work.
rules.justification: dev.aweiro.com and local hosts are not production; owner's existing decision carried over from Tripix

rules.reason: Ordinary work in the working tree.

//language: The table is bilingual, and the order it was extended in is load-bearing. Owners and agents phrase tasks in Russian; an action the table does not recognise falls to unmatched_class and the task cannot be claimed at all — on 2026-09-13 three tasks in the Tripix journal were stuck exactly there. Russian was therefore added to EVERY rule, and WIDER in the dangerous classes than in the safe ones: max-severity picks only among rules that MATCHED, so a Russian phrase matching SAFE_WRITE while its dangerous rule stays English-only is a hole, not a stricter default. ⛔ Cyrillic cannot sit next to \b or inside \w in JavaScript regexes (\w is [A-Za-z0-9_], so a word boundary before a Russian letter never fires) — the Russian branches use [а-яё] instead.
